about_the_game:
Sip'it is a varied drinking game that should not be missing at any party. It's every man for himself!
You can play with 9 other players on your computer.

You are able to complete various tasks, talk about your secrets and prove your skills.

How to play?

The game is played on a board game, with a dice you decide how far you can go and what task awaits you.
Depending on which field you land on, you can expect: Truth, Dare, Topics, Do or Drink and other Tasks.

Often the same players?

You have the option to create presets for your fellow players to speed up the start of the game!
So every name, gender and color of the player is adopted directly.

Customizable options:

Are you missing questions, tasks or topics?
No problem - you can design this individually according to your wishes at any time.
You can create new ones, delete old ones or change them completely.
You can also adjust the number of sips at your discretion.

Please drink responsibly.

This game is for entertainment purposes only.

content_descriptors.notes: Sip'it contains themes such as alcohol abuse, nudity & sexual contents.
